title: Fix broken GitHub Actions CI (build + Dokka failing on every push)
description: All workflow runs red on mainline: .github/workflows/build.yml and dokka.yml fail on push; pr.yml/release.yml unverified. Diagnose from failing run logs and fix. Track progress in comments so it can be resumed.
close_reason: FIXED — build + Dokka green on mainline (commit da6213c). Root causes: (1) action rot — Java 11 (Gradle 9 needs 17+), archived wrapper-validation-action@v1, Node-20 action versions, 'coretto' typo, dokka V1 task name under V2 mode, stale bucket4k cname; (2) krogue's includeBuild('../kotile') had no kotile on CI; (3) accumulated ktlint violations the broken CI never caught. Fixes: modernized all 4 workflows (setup-java 21, @v4 actions, gradle/actions/wrapper-validation@v4, dokka :dokkaGenerateHtml + build/dokka/html + permissions:contents:write + peaceiris@v4); added git-clone of kotile sibling; made kotile repo PUBLIC (user-approved) so the clone works; ran ktlintFormat. build+Dokka verified GREEN. pr.yml (PR-only) and release.yml (manual dispatch) fixed by the same patterns, verified by inspection not a live run. Note: GitHub warns @v4 actions still run on Node20 (informational, non-failing; GitHub auto-migrates to Node24).

comments.author: Kyle Sletmoe
comments.text: Diagnosis: dokka.yml uses Java 11 but Gradle 9.5.1 needs JVM17+ ('Gradle requires JVM 17 or later... configured to use JVM 11'). build.yml fails at gradle/wrapper-validation-action@v1 (archived, doesn't know Gradle 9.5.1 hash). All workflows use Node-20 actions (checkout@v3/setup-java@v3) that GitHub force-breaks 2026-06-16. dokka.yml has stale 'cname: bucket4k.sletmoe.com'. Plan: bump all setup-java to 21, modernize action versions, migrate wrapper validation to gradle/actions/wrapper-validation@v4, fix/remove cname.

comments.author: Kyle Sletmoe
comments.text: Fixes applied to all 4 workflows: setup-java 11->21, checkout/setup-java @v3->@v4, wrapper-validation-action@v1 -> gradle/actions/wrapper-validation@v4 (build,release), pr.yml 'coretto'->'corretto' + upload-artifact@v4 + dropped dead -XX:MaxPermSize, dokka.yml -> V2 task :dokkaGenerateHtml + publish_dir build/dokka/html + permissions:contents:write + dropped bucket4k cname + peaceiris@v4. Verified locally: ./gradlew build and :dokkaGenerateHtml both pass. Next: push, confirm build+Dokka runs go green; pr.yml only triggers on PRs (verified by inspection), release.yml is manual dispatch.

comments.author: Kyle Sletmoe
comments.text: Deeper root cause found: krogue settings.gradle.kts does includeBuild('../kotile') (composite build of the unpublished sibling), so CI build/dokka couldn't configure ('Included build .../kotile does not exist'). Added a 'git clone ksletmoe/kotile ../kotile' step to all 4 workflows before the gradle run. Action-version/Java/wrapper fixes already confirmed working (wrapper validation now passes; build now fails only on the missing kotile, now addressed). Pushing to verify green.

comments.author: Kyle Sletmoe
comments.text: BLOCKER (needs user decision): the kotile sibling repo is PRIVATE, so CI's 'git clone https://github.com/ksletmoe/kotile' fails ('could not read Username'). The default GITHUB_TOKEN is scoped to krogue only and cannot read a different private repo. Options: (1) make kotile public -> current plain-clone workflows go green as-is; (2) add a cross-repo access secret (PAT or deploy key) and switch the clone to use x-access-token:${{secrets.KOTILE_TOKEN}}; (3) publish kotile to a registry and depend on the artifact instead of includeBuild (bigger; ties into krogue-5-sonatype). All action-version/Java/wrapper/dokka-V2 fixes are done and confirmed (wrapper validation passes; build now fails ONLY at the kotile clone). Workflows left in place; final tweak depends on which option is chosen.

title: 4b step 7: Behavior + BehaviorSystem; delete legacy classes
description: Behavior(strategyId)+BehaviorSystem+Wander/HostileChase strategies. Delete Creature.update name==sheep/zombie branch and Creature/MovableEntity/old world.Entity.
close_reason: Behavior(strategyId) component + BehaviorStrategy/BehaviorStrategies (wander, hunt-player) + BehaviorSystem (injectable resolver) replace the interim name-based AI; creatures spawn with Behavior. Deleted all legacy world entity classes (MovableEntity, Entity, ZonalPosition, Pointer, HighlightedCoordinate); Tile made self-contained (was extending Entity). world/ is now GameWorld+Zone+Tile. 200 tests (+4), build+ktlint green.

title: 4b step 5: LightEmitter + LightingSystem
description: Lift Zone.recalculateLightMap into LightingSystem (query-driven); LightEmitter(color:NormalizedRgb, radius, calculatorId:String). Delete LightSource class + recalculateLightMap.
close_reason: LightingSystem recomputes each zone's lightMap from LightEmitter entities per tick (replaces Zone.recalculateLightMap). Added LightEmitter(color,radius,calculatorId) + LightCalculators registry. Zone keeps lightMap as system-written state, no longer owns lights. Player lantern is now a LightEmitter (tracks movement automatically; interim lantern glue removed). Deleted LightSource. ZoneLightingTest -> LightingSystemTest. 190 tests green.

title: 4b step 6: MoveIntent + MovementSystem + CombatSystem
description: Movement as data: MoveIntent consumed by MovementSystem (resolve vs isWalkable; blocked-into-occupied -> attack). Player input emits MoveIntent.
close_reason: Movement & combat are systems: MoveIntent + AttackIntent components; MovementSystem resolves MoveIntents (walk/ bump-attack->AttackIntent / wall no-op); CombatSystem applies damage + despawns dead non-player. MyGame registers movement->combat->lighting, routes player input + interim AI through MoveIntent, drops interim moveEntity/attack/dead-removal. Only name-based AI remains interim (->s7 BehaviorSystem). 196 tests (+6), build+ktlint green locally.

title: 4b step 3: rework Zone
description: Drop public Zone._creatures; isWalkable terrain-only (occupancy -> MovementSystem/World query); keep tiles+lightMap; add World.entityAt(zoneId,x,y).
close_reason: GameWorld composes ecs.World (ADR-0007); Zone is terrain-only (isWalkable terrain-only; creature ownership removed); occupants are ECS entities (Position+ZoneMember+Renderable+Health+Named, Player marker); added GameWorld.entityAt/isWalkable. Deleted Creature + old world.World. Interim movement/AI/lantern glue lives in MyGame, to be replaced by LightingSystem(s5)/MovementSystem+CombatSystem(s6)/BehaviorSystem(s7). 190 tests green.

title: Decide: reconcile ecs.World vs world.World
description: ecs.World (entity/system container) vs world.World (zones map + currentZoneId + World.create{zone{}} DSL). Options: (a) world.World composes ecs.World; (b) merge into one; (c) ecs.World gains a zone registry. Lean a/b. Preserve builder DSL. Settle FIRST; shapes steps 3-7.
close_reason: Decided: option (a) — GameWorld composes ecs.World; Zone becomes terrain-only; occupants become ECS entities tagged with ZoneMember. See docs/adr/0007-game-world-composes-ecs-world.md.

title: Player death + HP feedback (no game-over yet)
description: Discovered during 4b-s5 testing: the player takes combat damage (Health drops by 20 on a zombie bump) but there is no HP display and no death/game-over handling -- the player is excluded from dead-removal, so reaching 0 HP does nothing. Pre-existing gap, outside the 4b ECS-migration steps. Needs: surface player HP, and decide behavior at 0 HP (game-over / restart). Likely after Phase 4b; relates to krogue-ui-layout for any HUD.
